Name: Cute and Tidy Coops and Barns
Author: neuralwiles
Description:
I found myself missing the cozy vibes of similar coop and barn mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4226]Cuter Coops and Better Barns[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3874]Coop and Barn Facelift[/url], but wanted to make something new that was compatible with 1.6's autofeeder changes and which didn't change the size of the maps. So, I made this!


[size=4][i]Features[/i][/size]
  ♡  Tidied up maps for all size coops and barns. Removed broken planks, excess building materials, and the autofeeder graphics (autofeeders still function at the largest coop and barn sizes, though)! Let me know if there's interest in a version which adds them back in, because I can make that happen.
  ♡  Added cute decor around the floors and on the walls. Decor is from the town interior tilesheets, so it should be recolor compatible.
  ♡  Customizable wall color with 19 color options (including vanilla).


[i][size=4]Wall Color Config[/size][/i]
The easiest way to configure this mod is to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] in-game! The bold option is the default.

  ♡  Wall Color Options: "[b]Vanilla[/b]", "Blue", "Brown", "Chocolate", "Cream", "Green", "GreyBlue", "Lavender", "Orange", "PaleGold", "PastelPink", "Pink", "Purple", "Red", "RoseGold", "Rust", "SeaGreen", "Teal", "White"

[spoiler][img]https://i.imgur.com/Um7BoIC.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

[size=4][i]Compatibility[/i][/size]

This mod only uses base game assets, so any recolors you have which affect those should also be reflected here. Should also be compatible with interior recolors like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15049]Elegant Town Interiors[/url]!

This mod is probably not compatible with other mods that modify the coop and barn maps.


[size=4][i]Credits[/i][/size]

The alternate wall colors are courtesy of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4962196]nykachu[/url] thanks to the open permissions on their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3874]Coop and Barn Facelift[/url] mod!


If you enjoy this mod, check out my other map mods!
